definitions.explanation: A type of cloud forming a uniform gray or blue-gray sheet at middle altitudes (roughly 2,000–7,000 meters), often indicating approaching rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{高層雲|こうそううん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{覆|おお}われている→覆う：02020_oou⟧。
examples.english: The sky is covered by altostratus clouds.

examples.japanese: {高層雲|こうそううん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: When altostratus spreads, rain is often approaching.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気予報|てんきよほう}→天気予報：01678_tenkiyohou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{高層雲|こうそううん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厚|あつ}く→厚い：00690_atsui⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{伝|つた}えていた→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: The weather forecast said the altostratus would thicken from the afternoon and turn to rain by evening.

notes:
One of the ten basic cloud types classified by the World Meteorological Organization. Composed of ⟦{高層|こうそう}→高層：04145_kousou⟧ (high level) and {雲|うん} (cloud). Despite the name containing ⟦{高|こう}→高〜：03951_kou⟧ (high), {高層雲|こうそううん} forms at middle altitudes. The name reflects an older Japanese classification system.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高層雲|こうそううん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧ — altostratus spreads
- {高層雲|こうそううん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{覆|おお}われる→覆う：02020_oou⟧ — to be covered by altostratus
- ⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧{高層雲|こうそううん} — thick altostratus

- {乱層雲|らんそううん} — nimbostratus (rain-bearing cloud layer)
